items.title: 7.4 Safe and Responsible Information Utilization (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of safe information use (PDF 185).

blocks.text: Aaj ki duniya mein maloomat tak pohanchna aur use zimmedari se istemal karna bohat zaroori hai. Yeh hissa batata hai ke maloomat ko ehtiyat se kaise sambhalein: sources (maloomat kahan se aayi) ko samajhna, reliability (maloomat par kitna bharosa kiya ja sakta hai) pehchanna, aur yeh yaqeeni banana ke hum maloomat zimmedari se istemal karein.

blocks.prompt: Aaj maloomat ka zimmedari wala istemal pehle se zyada zaroori kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Online maloomat, chahe ghalat hi ho, foran bohat logon tak phail jati hai; baghair check kiye share karna jaldi se bohat logon ko ghalat raste par daal (mislead kar) sakta hai.

items: Maloomat ka mehfooz istemal: source samjhein, reliability pehchanein, zimmedari se istemal karein.
